title: Missing authentication in the conversation session resource handling of Unblu inc. (CVE-2026-78338)
description: CVE-2026-78338 is a vulnerability in Unblu inc.'s conversation session resource handling that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to download conversation session resources if they have the exact resource URL. This affects Unblu Spark versions 7.0 through 7.57.10 and 8.0 before 8.38.0 on both on-premises and cloud deployments. The resource URLs contain random identifiers that are not guessable, so an attacker must first obtain the exact URL to exploit this issue.
